penalties.title: Penalties
penalties.repeatPenaltyDescription: Reduces repetitions; the parameter name is adapted to the endpoint type.
penalties.dryHint: DRY parameters: ignored by endpoints that do not support them.

chunking.title: Over-context input chunking
chunking.description: When an input (your message plus text/PDF attachments) exceeds the context window, it is split into chapters analyzed one by one, then synthesized into a final answer.
chunking.enabledDescription: Triggers on the input itself: estimated too long at send time, or after a server context-overflow.
chunking.strategyDescription: Map-reduce analyzes each chapter independently; rolling carries a running summary across chapters.
chunking.fallbackContextDescription: Context window assumed when the server does not expose it (non llama.cpp models).
chunking.safetyFractionDescription: Fraction of the context budgeted per chapter, leaving room for the answer (0.1 to 0.95).
chunking.serverContextNote: Takes precedence over the fallback context above.

compaction.title: Conversation compaction
compaction.description: Automatically summarizes the start of long conversations so they keep fitting the context window, without losing the recent exchanges.
compaction.enabledDescription: Automatically compacts before sending when the context nears the threshold, and after a server context-overflow. Manual compaction stays available at any time.
compaction.thresholdDescription: Fraction of the context past which the conversation is compacted (0.1 to 0.95).
compaction.keepTurnsDescription: Number of latest exchanges kept verbatim, never summarized.

prompts.summaryPrefix: Summary of the beginning of the conversation (provided for context):
prompts.chunkedSourceSummary: [Large document provided, analyzed in {chapters} chapters. The consolidated analysis follows.]
prompts.chunkedSourcePartial: [Large document, partially analyzed before the run was stopped. Per-chapter analyses so far:]
prompts.summarizerSystem: You are condensing the beginning of a conversation so it fits within the model's context window. Produce a faithful, self-contained summary that preserves the facts, decisions, figures, code snippets and constraints, as well as any open questions. Be concise, with no meta introduction or conclusion, and reply in the language of the conversation.
prompts.defaultInstruction: Analyze this content and produce a complete synthesis of it.
prompts.analysisInstruction: You are analyzing a document too large to be processed in one go; it is split into parts and you are given ONE part. Analyze it independently, faithfully extracting the facts, ideas, data, decisions and key points it contains. Do not draw conclusions about the whole document: your analysis will be combined with that of the other parts. Reply in the language of the user's request.
prompts.rollingInstruction: You are analyzing a large document split into parts, processed in order. You are given the cumulative summary of the parts seen so far, then a new part. Update and enrich the analysis by integrating the new part into the existing summary, without losing the important information already gathered. Produce the updated cumulative summary.
prompts.synthesisInstruction: You are given the partial analyses of the different parts of a large document. Combine them into a single, coherent and complete final answer that responds to the user's request. Remove redundancies, keep the important information and structure the answer clearly.
prompts.runningSummaryLabel:
Cumulative summary of the previous parts:

{summary}
